name: Segment Anything 2.1 (SAM 2.1)
plain: Segment Anything 2.1 in image mode: masks from clicks, boxes or mask prompts, in four sizes.
summary: Segment Anything 2.1 (Ravi et al. 2024), image mode: promptable segmentation with a hierarchical Hiera image encoder, an FPN neck and the SAM prompt encoder / mask decoder with high-resolution skip features; masks from points, boxes and mask logits. `track` follows objects prompted on the first frame through a video with the original memory attention / memory encoder (`SAM2VideoPredictor`, forward, memory features in bfloat16 as upstream); the memory side has no fused kernels yet. Option `samurai` tracks as SAMURAI (Yang et al. 2024: a Kalman filter on the mask box picks among the multimask outputs, and the memory keeps only confident frames); upstream SAMURAI tracks one object, here every object has its own filter and memory. The portable `module()` is the image encoder only.

papers.title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos

task_io: Input: one image plus a point, box or text prompt. Output: masks with quality scores.

quality.title: COCO val2017, every 10th image, point prompts, mIoU best of 3 / single mask %
quality.protocol: One point per ground-truth instance (the interior point farthest from the border); IoU of the best-scored of 3 masks / of the single mask.

quality.title: DAVIS 2017 val, every 3rd sequence, video tracking, J&F / J / F %
quality.protocol: Semi-supervised: every object's first-frame mask as `input_masks`, `track` forward at 480p; the lower object id wins where masks overlap; J (IoU) and F (boundary) as davis2017-evaluation, mean over objects.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 3 % and p99 <= 15 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output `pred_masks`).
